items.title: jingyaogong/minimind
items.contentSnippet:
🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
https://jingyaogong.github.io/minimind

 
 

 
 
 
 
     
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
"大道至简"
 
 
 
 
中文 | English
 
 
 
 
此开源项目旨在完全从 0 开始，仅用 3 块钱成本与 2 小时训练时间，即可训练出规模约为 64M 的超小语言模型 MiniMind。
 
 
MiniMind 系列极其轻量，主线最小版本体积约为 GPT-3 的 $\frac{1}{2700}$，力求让普通个人 GPU 也能快速完成训练与复现。
 
 
项目同时开源了大模型的极简结构与完整训练链路，覆盖 MoE、数据清洗、预训练（Pretrain）、监督微调（SFT）、LoRA、RLHF（DPO）、RLAIF（PPO / GRPO / CISPO）、Tool Use、Agentic RL、自适应思考与模型蒸馏等全过程代码。
 
 
MiniMind 同时拓展了视觉模态模型 M

items.title: Show HN: Yolt – Your Personal TV
items.contentSnippet:
Clipping tools are ubiquitous these days.
Videos can be bulky, and hosted options are expensive.
Yolt never stores a video, full or clipped. A clip is just a start and end time on the original YouTube video, played through YouTube’s embedded player.
An LLM ranks the best moments, and new episodes are clipped automatically.
The TV tab plays all your clips back to back, with a QR code to open the full episode on your phone at that timestamp.

items.title: Show HN: Chili3D – Open-source browser CAD with parametric/push-pull modeling
items.contentSnippet:
Author here. Since my previous Show HN (https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=44238171), Chili3D has added three core modeling modules:
- Parametric: feature-tree editing + sketch constraints, with automatic downstream rebuild.
- AI-assisted: natural-language modeling in the browser with your own API key, producing editable features.
- Push/pull: history-free direct modeling—push/pull faces or profiles with automatic cut/join.
Repo: https://github.com/xiangechen/chili3d
Demo: https://chili3d.com
